1.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_MINSTREL_GREETING_000
1.description: Greetings, my friend. If you have a tale to share, this minstrel is all ears!

4.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_MINSTREL_NOSELECT_000
4.description: Oh, leaving so soon? I would be lying were I to say I wasn't disappointed, but I appreciate that a hero such as you has great demands upon <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> time. I shall look forward to hearing your adventures when you have a spare moment.

5.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_MINSTREL_NOCONTENT_000
5.description: ...Nothing for now? Not to put undue pressure upon you, but the folk here are quite taken by the songs inspired by your tales. They await the next with bated breath, and I hope to be able to deliver ere long─with inspiration from your good self.

6.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_000
6.description: Oho, what manner of thrilling adventure might this be?

7.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_001
7.description: Good gods, a battle on the moon with Zodiark, eldest and mightiest of primals... I pride myself on my imagination, but your feats transcend aught my mind could possibly conceive.

8.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_002
8.description: Against all odds, you struck down the puissant being, yet triumph quickly turned to tragedy, for Zodiark's fall proved to be the trigger for the Final Days...

9.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_003
9.description: ...Yes. Yes, the words well up within me. Pray lend them an ear.

10.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_004
10.description: Born of ancient men, a divinity was freed,♪<hex:02100103>Their hopes unrequited, they knew no reprieve.♪

11.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_005
11.description: Born of mortal men, a champion did arise,♪<hex:02100103>Ascending to the heavens, ruination to defy.♪

12.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_006
12.description: That the ancients should sacrifice half their number to save the star... The strength of their resolve makes me tremble in admiration.

13.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_007
13.description: Even as it saddens me to think that one of their own would seek to lay it all to waste, so deep was his despair...

14.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_008
14.description: Not having lived their lives, I feel decidedly unworthy to speak of their hearts. Better that the whole truth remain with you, and you alone.

15.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_009
15.description: Let it suffice for me to honor a fragment of their hopes and dreams in song, that their lives and sacrifice may ever be remembered.

16.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_010
16.description: Hm-hm, this promises to be a most rousing adventure!

17.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_011
17.description: In order to prove your readiness to avert the Final Days, you undertook a trial imposed by no less a being than the will of the star, Hydaelyn Herself...

18.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_012
18.description: It staggers the mind to imagine such an encounter, to say naught of the thousands of years that Venat had resolved to wait.

19.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_013
19.description: ...Yes, I daresay I have a song. You will listen to it now, of course?

20.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_014
20.description: Though eons apart, two kindred souls met,♪<hex:02100103>Apart they would walk, all life to protect.♪

21.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_015
21.description: Eons thence, their paths would converge,♪<hex:02100103>As goddess and mortal, to silence the dirge.♪

22.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_016
22.description: For time beyond counting, Hydaelyn waited for you in patience and faith. And when at last you were reunited, even as She desperately wished for you to surpass Her, She knew She could not hold back─and did not.

23.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_017
23.description: Hers was an unenviable burden...and a noble sacrifice. Tears well in my eyes to imagine the hardships She has had to endure.

24.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_018
24.description: But it comforts me to know that Her long journey was not in vain. That Her hopes passed on to you.

25.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_019
25.description: This tale is an epic among epics, and full honored am I to have been given the chance to weave a song for it. From the bottom of my heart, I thank you.

27.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_021
27.description: Quite some time has passed since that conflict drew to a close.

28.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_022
28.description: But having now survived the threat of the Final Days, I believe we may reflect more deeply upon the emotions that had driven man and dragon both. By all means, recount the tale for me.

30.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_024
30.description: I profess to weave words for a living...but on this occasion, they utterly fail me.

31.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_025
31.description: Yet this much, I will say: like an unwatched fire, pain and loss mustn't be left untended. For they were the embers that kindled a thousand-year conflict.

32.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_026
32.description: Tell me, my friend. Have you ever dwelled on that dark moment? Dwelled on what may have come to pass if the life which was lost was spared instead?

33.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_027
33.description: 'Tis said that there are no ifs in history, yet man is wont to cast his mind towards the path not walked.

34.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_028
34.description: In acknowledgement of this, I would sing of alternate eventualities...

35.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_029
35.description: By naught but vigilance may silver mail endure,<hex:02100103>Javelin's point never touch a comrade pure.♪

36.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_030
36.description: Look back upon the paths we failed to take,<hex:02100103>And prepare for the trials that lie in wait.♪

37.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_031
37.description: As you may have noticed, I drew inspiration from the words the Archon Louisoix wrote in his journals in allusion to the Dragonsong War.

38.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_032
38.description: Some may dismiss the exercise as wishful pining. But by thus reflecting upon the past, I believe that we shall be better braced for the future.

39.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_033
39.description: So when you have a quiet moment, perhaps you too might look back and imagine it─the tale as it might have unfolded...

40.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_040
40.description: A battle at the edge of existence, you say? Against a fearsome being known as the Endsinger...

41.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_041
41.description: It goes without saying that I should like to hear about this! Pray, recount to me the tale of your mission from beginning to end!

42.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_042
42.description: Good gods... I had known about the chaos of the Final Days, but never could I have imagined the events which brought them about.

43.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_043
43.description: I do wonder, though... Where might this Ultima Thule be located?

44.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_044
44.description: Lest you misunderstand, I speak not of its physical location. If we wished to know that, I daresay we could have the coordinates from the Loporrits.

45.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_045
45.description: Nay, my friend. What I speak of, rather, is its essence.

46.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_046
46.description: According to your description, 'tis a space where emotions dictate reality. It seems to me that, in such a place, it would be nigh impossible to draw a line between what is real and what is felt.

47.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_047
47.description: In nature, there is a phenomenon wherein the structure of a massive object may resemble that of something diminutive.

48.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_048
48.description: Might it not be possible, then, that the structure of the sea of stars resembles that of the heart and mind─of the complex mechanisms that govern our feelings?

49.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_049
49.description: On the assumption that it is so, I am led to wonder: what was the true nature of the Endsinger?

50.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_050
50.description: What was it exactly that you defied at the edge of existence?

51.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_051
51.description: Haha, these are just the wild ramblings of a minstrel. Pray do not lose sleep over it.

52.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_052
52.description: Still, I must say that the idea of an entity that hoards despair has quite roused my imagination. For instance...

53.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_053
53.description: Had the Endsinger succeeded in gathering but a few more stars' worth of despair─nay, perhaps even that of a few more souls─might the outcome have been different?

54.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_054
54.description: Yes, I believe I shall explore such an eventuality in song!

55.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_055
55.description: The light of hope kindled by your comrades is brilliant. Alas, so dark is the despair you face, not even that light can pierce it...

56.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_056
56.description: An inexorable verse of oblivion, performed at the farthest reaches of existence... I shall name it: the Endsinger's Aria!

57.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_060
57.description: Good gods, a battle in the void! You've certainly wasted no time seeking out newfound adventure... By all means, regale me with the thrilling details!

58.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_061
58.description: A world without death, where the strong devour the weak... And a woman touched by Darkness, who possesses the power to seal voidsent... Fascinating stuff indeed.

59.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_062
59.description: But this archfiend Barbariccia, as cruel as she is ravishing... Though she is fearsome enough by your account, I cannot help but wonder: what if she had devoured more of the great wyrm's aether? How terribly bright might her soul have shone then?

60.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_063
60.description: ...Yes, they come to me, the beginnings of a new verse. Pray listen, if you will.

61.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_064
61.description: In armor black, from shadowed lair,♪<hex:02100103>The knight, with steely voice, declared.♪<hex:02100103>A dragon's freedom he did steal,♪<hex:02100103>Vict'ry in his crusade to seal.♪

62.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_065
62.description: Wind made flesh, the archfiend fair,♪<hex:02100103>Her pride, her long and lustrous hair.♪<hex:02100103>On dragon soul she feasted well,♪<hex:02100103>A tempest freed to toll the knell.♪

63.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_066
63.description: Fighting to devour. Devouring to fight. Should the day come when this wheel is broken, would a voidsent greet her end with a wail of anguish? Or would she heave a sigh of relief?

64.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_067
64.description: Whichever it may be, 'tis ironic to think that a soul who had sought freedom, and for so long, should end up being imprisoned in cold crystal.

65.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_068
65.description: Thus I would sing of that final battle. For in that lightless world, 'tis in such a moment, I believe, that their lives shine the brightest.

66.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_070
66.description: The voidsent thought to cross the rift and launch an assault on our world? Goodness, and here I thought you might find a reprieve from your dealings with the void and its denizens. Pray, tell me more.

67.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_071
67.description: I see... Theirs was a world bereft of true death, and so they sought its release in ours. A most curious impetus to take action, would you not agree?

68.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_072
68.description: And this Rubicante... He too was prepared to embrace his end with open arms. Yet I cannot help but wonder: had he drank deeper of the dragon's aether, how brightly might his soul have burned ere it flickered and failed?

69.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_073
69.description: Hmmm... I do believe this quandary has inspired the makings of a new verse. If you might lend me your ear a moment?

70.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_074
70.description: In armor black, the knight did ride♪<hex:02100103>To claim lands wherein death resides.♪<hex:02100103>Thither would his people know♪<hex:02100103>The silent gift of death's great flow.♪<hex:02100103>

71.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_075
71.description: Honor bound, a fiend of fire.♪<hex:02100103>Forged in battle, honed by ire.♪<hex:02100103>He stood defiant, soul ablaze,♪<hex:02100103>Heart heavy with sins of bygone days.♪<hex:02100103>

72.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_076
72.description: In another life, one might say he had the heart of a hero true. A heart broken, perhaps, by the bitter truth that the void could not be saved without sacrifice.

73.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_077
73.description: Yet he was willing to offer up his soul to become a monster, dying to uphold his ideals. A heroic sacrifice in his eyes, no doubt.

74.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_078
74.description: The circumstances of his death aside, I believe such a noble soul is worthy of remembrance in song, that people may look back on the man that he was rather than the beast he became.

75.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_080
75.description: Ah, the dreadful machine of war. Pray describe its every detail, that I might conjure an image in my mind.

76.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_081
76.description: A four-legged entity, armored as if in a shiny black carapace. Like a beetle forged from darkened steel...

77.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_082
77.description: Hmmm. Why does that description sound so very familiar?

78.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_083
78.description: Ah, yes! I have seen this contraption trundling about town!

79.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_084
79.description: Yet surely that cannot be the same deadly Omega of which you speak? Such a tiny thing, and its chocobo-like companion seems so sweet and inquisitive.

80.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_085
80.description: ...Fascinating. You say Omega's prime directive was to improve itself through battle. Thus did it conduct an “interdimensional experiment” following its awakening in the present day.

81.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_086
81.description: A process through which it hoped to define─and ultimately adopt─the intangible strength of mortal spirit...

82.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_087
82.description: And the being known as Alpha was created to facilitate this pursuit?

83.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_088
83.description: Yet how does one define the heart of man?

84.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_089
84.description: We never question that we all possess such heart, and I have witnessed myself how unyielding hope can manifest with palpable effect.

85.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_090
85.description: The underlying concept, however, is nebulous at best. If we lacked the terms to describe it, would we even recognize its existence within ourselves?

86.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_091
86.description: Put another way, should we lack the means to be aware of such indefinable strength, could it still potentially exist?

87.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_092
87.description: Pray excuse my philosophical musings. I am merely entertaining the possibilities.

88.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_093
88.description: Yet what is a minstrel for, if not to entertain the idea of that which might be?

89.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_094
89.description: If Omega's experiment had continued a while longer, would it have arrived at the answer it sought? Let us imagine the tableau...

90.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_095
90.description: Omega... The dreaded machine of war which slumbered 'neath the fields of Carteneau.

91.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_096
91.description: Upon being awoken, 'tis said that this steel-clad terror made straightway to the border of the Black Shroud and the Fringes, whereupon a titanic struggle took place.

92.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_097
92.description: Did Omega seek conflict of its own accord? Or was it merely following commands...?

93.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_098
93.description: Aye, a subject to stir the imagination...not to mention my minstrel heart!

94.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_099
94.description: Emerged with haste in skies above,♪<hex:02100103>The beast knew neither hate nor love.♪<hex:02100103>A heartless shell of living steel,♪<hex:02100103>Seeking might with ceaseless zeal.♪<hex:02100103>

95.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_100
95.description: It takes the measure of the strong,♪<hex:02100103>Learns which upon the field belong.♪<hex:02100103>The endless strife, an endless test,♪<hex:02100103>With soul unknown, it knows no rest.♪<hex:02100103>

96.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_110
96.description: Ah, the knight clad in armor black... Pray tell me of your encounter with him beyond the veil─and spare no detail.

97.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_111
97.description: So the true motive for his crusade was the salvation of his brethren. Thus did he pervert Azdaja's yearning to return home into a force capable of breaking down the barrier between worlds.

98.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_112
98.description: For one that speaks of deliverance, concocting a plot that would condemn the souls of another world to death rings decidedly unheroic...

99.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_113
99.description: Nonetheless, I feel inspired with a new verse. Pray lend me your ears.

100.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_114
100.description: For home, the shackled wyrm did yearn,♪<hex:02100103>Stained by shadow, her nature turned.♪<hex:02100103>In Darkness did her captor swear,♪<hex:02100103>To claim his kind their stolen share.♪<hex:02100103>

101.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_115
101.description: Only salvation would suffice,♪<hex:02100103>Another world to pay the price.♪<hex:02100103>Hailed hero, or branded villain,♪<hex:02100103>Deeds never to be forgiven.♪<hex:02100103>

102.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_116
102.description: What could have driven him to such ends? To sacrifice the very souls he hoped to save? To give rise to an entity born of such sorrow as Zeromus?

103.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_117
103.description: He is worthy of contempt for his deeds, of that, there is no doubt. Yet all was done for the salvation of his people... One cannot help but be drawn to such a tale.

104.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_120
104.description: The dread beast Zeromus. 'Twas a battle that shook the very heavens, I'm sure. Naught less would befit an adversary named for a fallen champion of the Thirteenth. If you are willing to share, a captive audience stands before you.

105.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_121
105.description: Hoho, so you countered baleful Dark with resplendent Light. And what a fascinating twist to the tale for Zero, denizen of the void, to wield it. To be possessed of the strength of spirit to forge her own future in so brazen a fashion!

106.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_122
106.description: Though in truth, knowing she is part voidsent, I would have expected the Light to refuse her outright. I shudder to think what might have happened if it had. To her, to Azdaja, to this very star...

107.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_123
107.description: From musings of darkest despair springs forth a song of hope. If I may...

108.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_124
108.description: From dregs of Dark did Zeromus rise,♪<hex:02100103>To claim the flesh of wyrm as its guise.♪<hex:02100103>Bereft of death, its kin left to weep,♪<hex:02100103>As fiend unleashed sought home and release.♪

109.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_125
109.description: From selfsame shade did rise a dark knight,♪<hex:02100103>A void-kissed child now graced by the Light.♪<hex:02100103>'Twas she who dared to defy her fate,♪<hex:02100103>And by her hand damnation's wheel break.♪

110.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_126
110.description: For a mercy, it seems Zero has found a way to save not only her voidsent kin, but her home as well. And while Golbez may have committed terrible deeds, that he yet lives means that he may yet do good.

111.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_127
111.description: The nigh-fathomless Darkness of Zeromus contained within the memoria crystal shall pave a path of newfound hope.

112.name: TEXT_CTSOPN60WANDERINGMINSTREL_00728_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_128
112.description: An arduous path, to be sure, but one they shall walk together. And at journey's end, I pray, the Thirteenth will flourish with life once more.
